requirement.summary: General V3 membership interface - Incorrect request ID for prepare refund coupon if there are multiple check discount coupon with the same discount type
requirement.description:
It is available for General V3 membership interface

System posts incorrect requestCompletionId for external API "Prepare Refund Coupon" when doing coupon refund

System applied multiple coupons. Each of them belongs to the same check discount type.

Workflow

1. Open a check attached with General V3 member

2. Click function "SVC Coupon Enquiry"

3. Input coupon number for enquiry

4. Click button "Apply Coupon"

5. System triggers external API “Prepare Redeem Coupon” and apply the coupon discount with type as check discount

6. Select another target coupon

7. Click button “Apply Coupon”

8.  System triggers external API “Prepare Redeem Coupon” and apply the coupon discount with type as check discount

9. Return to ordering panel

10. Click function “Void Check Discount” or “Void Multiple Item Discount” to void the discount coupons

11.  System triggers external API "Prepare Refund Coupon" with the requestCompletionId from the last coupon "Redeem Coupon" response

Expected Result:

System should use the requestCompletionId from corresponding "Redeem Coupon" response in “Prepare Refund Coupon”
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68800] General V3 membership interface - Incorrect request ID for prepare refund coupon if there are multiple check discount coupon with the same discount type (Teresa)
Descriptions:
It is available for General V3 membership interface
System posts incorrect requestCompletionId for external API "Prepare Refund Coupon" when doing coupon refund for checks having multiple coupon check discount
Workflow
1. Open a check attached with General V3 member
2. Click function "SVC Coupon Enquiry"
3. Input coupon number for enquiry
4. Click button “Apply Coupon”
5. System triggers external API “Prepare Redeem Coupon” and apply the coupon discount with type as check discount
6. Select another target coupon
7. Click button “Apply Coupon”
8. System triggers external API “Prepare Redeem Coupon” and apply the coupon discount with type as check discount
9. Return to ordering panel
10. Click function “Void Check Discount” or “Void Multiple Item Discount” to void the discount coupons
11. System triggers external API "Prepare Refund Coupon" with the requestCompletionId from the last coupon "Redeem Coupon" response
Expected result:
System should use the requestCompletionId from corresponding "Redeem Coupon" response in “Prepare Refund Coupon”
It is fixed in current version

requirement.summary: General V3 membership interface - SVC coupon enquiry prompts error "Incorrect category type" if interface setup "Discount Details From" value as "Infrasys POS discount setup"
requirement.description:
It is available for General V3 membership.

Error message "Incorrect category type" is shown during SVC Coupon Enquiry if Discount Details From is set as "Infrasys POS discount setup"

The remark "Only for category "item" or "check"" should be removed

Prerequisite:{

- Location: Interface Control > Interfaces

- Discount Details From = Infrasys POS discount setup

Workflow:

- Open a new check

- Add an item

- Click function "SVC Coupon Enquiry"

- Input coupon number

- Click button "Enquiry"

- System shows error "Incorrect category type"

Actual result:

System should not show error "Incorrect category type" and show coupon information

The remark should be removed
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68637] General V3 membership interface - SVC coupon enquiry prompts error "Incorrect category type" if interface setup "Discount Details From" value as "Infrasys POS discount setup" (Teresa)
Descriptions:
It is available for General V3 interface
If the value of interface outlet config “Discount Details From” is set as “Infrasys POS discount setup”, system fails to apply coupon discount
Workflow
1. Open a new check
2. Add an item
3. Click function “SVC Coupon Enquiry”
4. Input target coupon number
5. Click button “Enquiry”
6. The system triggers external party API to enquire coupon
7. The system shows error “Incorrect category type” and aborts applying corresponding coupon discount
Expected result:
System should not show error “Incorrect category type”
System shows coupon information
The coupon discount from Infrasys POS can be applied
Remarks of interface outlet config “Discount Details From” is set as “Infrasys POS discount setup” is updated to ‘Only for function “SVC Coupon Enquiry”’
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
Setting discount details from Infrasys POS discount setup for General V3 interface
Go to Infrasys POS platform: Interface Control à Interfaces
Select target General v3 membership interface setting
Click “Add New” to add a new record or select an existing interface record
Select section “Coupon Setup”
Discount Details From = Infrasys POS discount setup
Click “Save” to save the record
For detailed setup of General V3 (HMC) membership interface, please refer to “Infrasys_cloud_pos_release_note_1_0_64_0(Infrasys Cloud v1.2.64.0).docx”

requirement.summary: Unexpected set menu parent item added to ordering basket if continuously fast clicking parent item in menu lookup page
requirement.description:
Pre-condition:

- Mobile view

- Self-select set menu in Menu Lookup page

- Fast clicking

Workflow

1. Login POS client in mobile view

2. Open a check

3. Click a Menu button to open a menu lookup page

4. Continuously fast click the set menu parent item before the set menu lookup page prompted for child item selection

5. Select target child item and click button "OK"

6. Duplicated set menu parent item is added to ordering basket

Expected result:

- Redundant set menu parent item should not be added in ordering basket
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68624] Unexpected set menu parent item added to ordering basket if continuously fast clicking parent item in menu lookup page
Descriptions:
The system added an unexpected set menu parent item in ordering basket if the following criteria are met:
Under mobile view
Click a self-select set menu parent item rapidly on the menu lookup page
Workflow
1. Login POS client in mobile view
2. Open a check
3. Click a Menu button to open a menu lookup page
4. Continuously click rapidly on the set menu parent item on the menu lookup page before the set menu lookup page prompts for child item selection
5. Select target child item and click button “OK”
6. Duplicated set menu parent item is added to ordering basket
Expected result:
Redundant set menu parent item should not be added in ordering basket
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
Add set menu parent item to Menu
Go to Infrasys POS platform: Menu Management  Item Properties  Menus
Edit Content for an existing menu ()
Add target set menu parent item as below:
Click “Save” to save record
Add a Menu button to the display panel page
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Station Setup à Display Panels
Select the target ordering display panel zone
Edit content () of the target display panel page
Click button “Add New Button” to add new button
Select
Type = Menu
Available Options = Target menu created in previous step
Fill in the remaining details
Click “Submit” at the bottom
Click “Save” at the top of the page to save the changes
